title: SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation
abstract: arXiv:2610.18672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. translated_title: SMI：基于本体的语义标识符实现层次感知的医学概念表示
translated_abstract: 生物医学语言模型（LMs）为临床任务提供了强大的表示能力，但它们往往无法捕捉医学概念之间的层次结构。这一局限性在长尾词表中的罕见和细粒度临床编码上尤为突出，因为随着概念频率的降低，与层次无关的语言模型表示所包含的信息越来越少。我们提出了语义医学标识符（SMI），这是一个无需训练的框架，用于构建基于本体的语义ID以及层次感知的医学概念表示。对于每个诊断、手术操作或药物概念，SMI将其语义ID定义为该概念在专家定义的医学本体中从粗到细的路径。随后，SMI在相应的本体层级上聚合冻结的生物医学语言模型嵌入，形成保留从粗到细临床语义的层次感知医学概念表示。基础版SMI在各层级上采用均匀聚合的方式……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出无需训练的SMI框架，通过将医学概念映射为专家定义医学本体中从粗到细的语义路径，并聚合冻结生物医学语言模型在各本体层级的嵌入，构建层次感知的医学概念表示，尤其改善了长尾词表中罕见和细粒度临床编码的表示效果。
en_tdlr: SMI is a training-free framework that constructs ontology-grounded Semantic IDs by mapping each medical concept to its coarse-to-fine path in an expert-defined medical ontology and aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations, particularly improving representations of rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies.
